mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 3.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals manufacturing sector contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained employment growth above 150,000 new jobs per month (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS > 150,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation above 3.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals the Federal Reserve will maintain restrictive monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% signal aggressive monetary tightening amid persistent inflation, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1500 thousand units) signals robust consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days during late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
